h1: Krabi Resort — A Beachfront Ao Nang Resort with the Only Private Beach in the Area
intro: In an Ao Nang where most hotels make you cross a road to reach the sand, Krabi Resort is the exception — a Thai-style resort that sits directly on Ao Nang Beach, and the only property in the area with its own private beach area. It's a veteran resort of around 215 rooms, spread out as bungalows and villas across large tropical gardens, ranging from standard rooms up to a Beachfront Pool Villa. What guests love is the location and the garden-by-the-sea atmosphere — but you do have to accept that the buildings and rooms are showing their age. From approx. ฿2,500/night.

body.html: Krabi Resort is a veteran Ao Nang property set directly on the beach, spread across large grounds with around 215 rooms, bungalows and villas dotted through leafy tropical gardens. The selling point every review agrees on is its beachfront location — this is the only resort in Ao Nang with its own private beach area, so you can walk from your room straight onto the sand without crossing a road like most hotels here. At the same time you can still walk to Ao Nang Walking Street, restaurants and the pier, so you get both the calm of the seafront and the convenience of the town.

Rooms span many tiers, from a 30-sqm Deluxe in the hotel building, up through Luxury Grand Rooms, Pool rooms you can slide into the water from, and higher-end villas like the 143-sqm Tropical Pool Villa and the 180-sqm Beachfront Pool Villa with a private pool in the garden. Many reviews praise the rooms and villas as bigger than expected, with beautiful, leafy grounds. But there's an honest caveat: the buildings and rooms are showing their age — furniture and bathrooms in many rooms look dated, and some guests found weak air-con, a broken safe, or a musty smell. This is a resort that sells on location and atmosphere, not on being new.

"Walked straight from the bungalow onto our own private beach in the morning, no road to cross, quiet leafy gardens — you can't find a location like this in Ao Nang, but the rooms really do show their age."

Beyond the private beach, there are also two outdoor pools set among the gardens, relaxed and uncrowded. There's an in-resort restaurant, a spa and a fitness center, and breakfast earns praise for variety in many reviews, though some note limited vegetarian options. The real draw of a stay here is waking up to wander the wide seafront gardens in a way that a small resort in the center of Ao Nang simply can't offer.

The thing to weigh carefully is condition and upkeep. Being an older resort, several reviews mention inconsistent maintenance — the pool, bar or parts of the grounds can look tired, housekeeping is sometimes slow, and there are mosquitoes when the gardens are damp. Some guests also ran into rooms that didn't match the booking photos or were reassigned at check-in. If you expect a 4-star resort where everything is new and spotless, this may not be it — but if you can take the vintage condition in exchange for a beachfront setting, it's a hard combination to replace elsewhere.

With 7.9 from 176 reviews on Trip.com, a location score of around 9.1 on Booking.com, and 3.7/5 on TripAdvisor (ranked #95 of 202 Ao Nang hotels from over 2,196 reviews), the numbers paint a clear picture: Krabi Resort is a place where the location scores top marks while the room condition pulls the overall score down. It suits travelers who value being right on a private beach with sprawling gardens over having a brand-new room. The tip is to choose a villa- or Grand-tier room that's been renovated more recently, and to read the latest reviews before you book.

For anyone who wants a genuine beachfront resort feel in Ao Nang without traveling all the way out to Tubkaak or Klong Muang, Krabi Resort still has a charm of its own. Just understand you're paying for the seafront land and the resort's history, not for a new luxury room. Set your expectations to match what you'll actually get, and it delivers seaside time that brings plenty of guests back for a repeat stay.

honestSummary: Krabi Resort is a place where the beachfront location and private beach are a draw no one else in Ao Nang can match. The large tropical gardens, calm atmosphere and room range from bungalows to pool villas are what guests remember — but you have to accept that the buildings and rooms are aging and upkeep is inconsistent. This is a resort that sells on location and charm, not on being new.
honestChecks: If you expect a brand-new, spotless 4-star room throughout — many buildings and rooms are aging, with dated furniture and bathrooms → choose a Grand-tier or villa room that's been renovated more recently, and read the latest reviews before booking.

If you're sensitive to cleanliness or wary of mosquitoes — some reviews note a musty smell, slow housekeeping and mosquitoes when the gardens are damp → ask to switch rooms at check-in if it's not right, and bring insect repellent.
If you want a new luxury beachfront resort — Krabi Resort is vintage beachfront, not new luxury → for new high-end seafront, look at Tubkaak or Klong Muang instead.

tips.title: Pick a Grand-tier or villa room
tips.body: The standard Deluxe rooms are older than the rest. If your budget allows, choose a Luxury Grand or a villa that's been renovated more recently to avoid the most tired rooms.

tips.title: Make the most of the private beach
tips.body: The private beach is something no other Ao Nang property offers. Walk down for a morning swim before the crowds arrive at the public beach next door.

tips.title: Bring insect repellent
tips.body: The gardens are large and leafy, but there are mosquitoes in the rainy season or when the grounds are damp. Pack repellent and ask the front desk for a mosquito coil.

tips.title: Inspect your room at check-in
tips.body: Some reviews mention rooms not matching the photos or broken fixtures. Test the air-con, safe and hot water at check-in, and ask to switch right away if anything's off.

faq.q: Where is Krabi Resort, and is it really on the beach?
faq.a: It's at 232 Moo 2, right on Ao Nang Beach, Mueang Krabi · it's the only property in Ao Nang with its own private beach area, so you walk from your room onto the sand without crossing a road · about a 7-minute walk to Ao Nang Walking Street and 10 minutes to the pier · around 30 minutes by car from Krabi Airport (KBV).

faq.q: How much does Krabi Resort cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿2,500/night for a 30-sqm Deluxe room · stepping up to Luxury Grand Rooms, a Luxury Grand Pool you can step into the water from, and higher-end villas like the Tropical Pool Villa and the 180-sqm Beachfront Pool Villa with a private pool · prices vary by season and package, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Krabi Resort best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for travelers who want a beachfront resort with large tropical gardens in Ao Nang without traveling out to Tubkaak or Klong Muang · it suits those who can take vintage condition in exchange for a private-beach setting · it's less suited to anyone who needs a brand-new, spotless 4-star room throughout, since the buildings and rooms are showing their age.

faq.q: Are the rooms dated, and how should I choose one?
faq.a: Being an older resort, many standard Deluxe rooms are aging, with dated furniture and bathrooms · it's worth choosing a Luxury Grand or a more recently renovated villa, and reading the latest reviews before booking · test the air-con, safe and hot water at check-in and ask to switch right away if anything's off.

faq.q: What are the pools and private beach like at Krabi Resort?
faq.a: There are two outdoor pools set among the tropical gardens, calm and uncrowded · plus a private beach right by the resort, something you won't find at other Ao Nang properties · head down in the morning before the crowds reach the public beach next door for the quietest atmosphere.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, and is cancellation flexible?
faq.a: In high season (November–April), book 3–6 weeks ahead, especially the Pool rooms and seafront villas, which are limited in number · most platforms offer a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't firm, or in case you need to request a room change at check-in.
